title: ZAAFVesper event record for ZAAFElegia, schema zaafvesper.elegia/1
description: One line of --elegia-out or of an --elegia-dir segment. Sigma field names (Image, CommandLine, DestinationIp, ...) come from pkg/sigmamap for the event's logsource category; everything ZAAFVesper adds lives under zaafvesper, so the flat namespace stays Sigma's.

EventID.description: Sysmon-compatible event id; absent for events without a Sysmon equivalent.

UtcTime.description: UTC, Sysmon format; ZAAFElegia reads it as the event time.

Computer.description: Host name of the sensor (Sysmon's field name).

Initiated.description: network_connection: outbound (true) or inbound (false); absent for a listening socket.

truncated.description: Present when the record was cut to its size cap.

name.description: Canonical event name (pkg/event), e.g. CreateProcess, NetworkConnect.

identity.description: The process identity came from the kernel, not from an exec event: no signing data.

^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$.description: Sigma field names of the record's category (pkg/sigmamap.ExportFields). Strings, integers (pids, ports, event ids) or lists of strings; booleans are the strings true/false, as in Sysmon.

unique_id.description: macOS kernel per-boot unique process id (p_uniqueid).
macOS kernel per-boot unique process id (p_uniqueid); the zaafvesper pipeline maps ProcessGuid to it on macOS.

cs_category.description: Code-signing validation category (platform, developer_id, app_store, local_signing, ...).

seeded.description: Learned at start-up, not from an exec event.
